donor_parity: Static parity with the AWSS3 suppression set (6 hook sites, 23 URL fragments, 12 body fragments, decoy/fake 200, netdata.bin); runtime donor A/B was not performed.

device_test.scope: User signed, installed and played one match with v16; no crash or hang reported in this session. The mod/menu was in use.

traffic_capture.method: Windows Mobile Hotspot (Wi-Fi 4) + Wireshark: DNS, TLS SNI and TCP SYN.
traffic_capture.interpretation: These endpoints use native/proprietary paths outside the ported NSURLSession/NSURLConnection hooks. AWSS3 hooks the same APIs, so this matches donor scope. beacon.qq, beacon-tj.qq, snowflake.qq, dd.garena.com and bugly-aos.cros.garena were not observed.
traffic_capture.limitation: Partial capture; it does not prove server-side suppression.

unported_donor_features: keychain/token deletion and apiclient license flow
30-second timer, UIApplication launch observer and [ANHVU]/[AOVCHEAT] NSLog strings
signing: Ad-hoc module container only; full certificate re-signing of the IPA and frameworks is required before installation.
